fit: kefir exposure and Parkinson fall frequency
assessment: Gut-bone review describes kefir as fermented food containing microbial products; no isolated Parkinson outcome.

fit: egg exposure and Parkinson fall frequency
assessment: Infant probiotic trial lists egg sensitivity as an adverse-event category; it does not test a poached-egg intervention.

fit: grape exposure and Parkinson anxiety severity
assessment: The narrative review discusses grape-derived polyphenols and grape-rich feeding in nonclinical metabolic models. No dietary whole-grape result for the assigned Parkinson outcome is isolated.

fit: coffee exposure and Parkinson fatigue severity
assessment: Coffee abstention is part of the autonomic assessment protocol in Wilson disease. The study supplies no coffee treatment comparison.

fit: olive oil exposure and Parkinson walking slowness
assessment: Anti-aging review names olive-oil-derived hydroxytyrosol in mechanistic context, not isolated culinary PD treatment.

fit: shrimp exposure and Parkinson constipation severity
assessment: Oligosaccharide review cites fish and shrimp farming applications, not shrimp consumption or a Parkinson outcome.

fit: saffron exposure and Parkinson fall frequency
assessment: Historical pharmacopoeia review identifies saffron in an aloe-myrrh-lemon mixed pill, with no measured Parkinson depression outcome.
